name: @tellma/locale-ar
description: Arabic locale pack for Tellma distributions — library strings (Transloco scope) plus the self-hosted Noto Sans Arabic font subset.

Born at 0.41 KB measured: provideTellmaLocaleAr and tmArabic, which loads the strings entry point with import(). Measured 0.44 once tmArabic loads ./platform-strings and ./strings together, within the ceiling.
budgetNotes../platform-strings: Born at 2.84 KB measured, the ceiling being that measurement rounded up to the next 0.5 KB, by the re-split of ./strings that replaced its third raise: the platform's Arabic tm table (every block of it, from the home and settings titles, the errors, the session, the update banner, the navigation, the launcher and the shell to the entity strings, the attention surfaces and the arrival toasts, the typed values and the picker), which tmArabic loads beside ./strings on the first switch to Arabic and an app on the component library alone never loads.
budgetNotes../strings: Born at 6.39 KB measured: the component library's Arabic and the platform's Arabic table. An app loads it on the first switch to Arabic, never in its initial bundle. Raised from 6.5 to 7 for the typed values' Arabic strings: measured 6.47 before and 6.59 after (+0.12 KB), the ceiling being that measurement rounded up to the next 0.5 KB. The weight is the tm.value block (Yes and No, the file label, the file picker's label with its gendered imperative, and the too-large, wrong-type and upload-failed errors). The platform's Arabic offline banner string (spec 0028) adds 0.05 KB on merging: measured 6.59 before and 6.64 after, within the same ceiling. Kept at 7 for the launcher's core sections and My settings entries with their search synonyms: measured 6.64 before and 6.83 after, within the ceiling. The weight is the Arabic of the Analysis and Administration sections and of the four My settings sections, and the launcher's Arabic synonyms of three of them. Raised from 7 to 8 for the Arabic of the error presentation, the session's paths and the update banner: measured 6.83 before and 7.94 after (+1.11 KB), the ceiling being that measurement rounded up to the next 0.5 KB. The weight is the error table's Arabic (each kind's heading and message, the forbidden reasons, the tenant states, the step-up question, the update download's busy label, failure and Reload anyway), the session's (the sign-out wait and question with their plural forms, the signing-out and signed-out overlays, the session-ended dialog and the sign-out failure) and the update banner's message. Nothing was saved: every string is one the user reads, and the pack loads only on the first switch to Arabic. Re-split instead of a third raise: the attention surfaces' Arabic took the merged entry point to 8.36 against 8 (7.94 before), so the platform's tm table moved to ./platform-strings and this entry point keeps the component library's Arabic alone, measured 5.88, the ceiling being that measurement rounded up to the next 0.5 KB.
budgetNotes._: Ceilings are ratchets. Any raise belongs here with its reason; a raise with no note is a bug.
